title: The shift change, the last
logline: The last shift change, 1994: the day men walking out through the gate as the night men walk in, from above, two lines of backs crossing, the stack between them. The page draws the crossing and not the faces.

panels.composition: From above: a mill gate with two lines of men crossing, one walking out and one walking in, backs and hard hats, the stack beyond, black spotting for the shadows.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, seen from above, a mill gate with two lines of men crossing, one walking out and one walking in, hard hats and backs, a brick stack beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
